evidence.quote: To connect your VPC to X-Ray, you define an [interface VPC endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpce-interface.html). The endpoint provides reliable, scalable connectivity to X-Ray without requiring an internet gateway, network address translation (NAT) instance, or VPN connection.
Interface VPC endpoints are powered by AWS PrivateLink, an AWS technology that enables private communication between AWS services by using an elastic network interface with private IP addresses.
